chapter: Studio recordings of the late twenties and thirties
title: Ormandy Okeh sides and the drummer question
summary: Kline notes Rust is unsure whether Morehouse or Stan King played on Ormandy's Okeh records; Morehouse does not recall them.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Okay. We're back to Eugene Ormandy. We did some more records for him. Interestingly, the Brian Rust discography is unsure whether you or Stan King were playing drums with Eugene Ormandy. When they did some Okeh records. "Go To Bed," "Dance Away the Night," Like "A Breath of Springtime". Do you remember any of those?
